title: Don't have ringtone
body:
Why don't have ringtone? only reminder for habit plan? 
I use this app to build my habit, and need ringtone to tell me like "HEY, WAKE UP AND DO YOUR TASK".
But I only received reminder like " Do you forget to do habit" ?? Yes, I don't have this habit, so I forgot about that. Do I need to build habit to remember to open the app to do habit plan that I build??
